name: 17065 · Mt Holly Spgs, PA
findings: ZIP 17065 (Mt Holly Spgs) has 23 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (70% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 17065 (Mt Holly Spgs) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
